We need to test that run method delegates to overloaded method with startIndex and finishIndex using barSeries.getBeginIndex() and getEndIndex(). We can mock barSeries to return specific indices. So we can spy the BarSeriesManager to verify that internal call occurs with correct parameters. Use Mockito.spy on a real instance, then stub the deeper run method to return a dummy TradingRecord. Then call the method under test and assert returned record.

Also need to mock Strategy, TradeType (enum), Num, TradingRecord.

- @Mock Strategy strategyMock;

- stub manager.run(strategyMock, any(Trade.TradeType.class), any(Num.class), eq(0), eq(10)) to return tradingRecordMock.

- Choose tradeType: Trade.TradeType.BUY maybe; but enum not mocked; we can use Trade.TradeType.BUY.

- In test method: call manager.run(strategyMock, Trade.TradeType.BUY, amountMock); assert same tradingRecordMock.

- Verify that inner run called once with correct args.
